technical_conclusion.conditional_at_most_once: If every old/new entry retains this exact ordering and exact canonical ROOT, and ROOT is never removed/renamed/recreated, at most one entry can win mkdir and reach its internal launch dispatch. Two entries passing the earlier absence checks do not defeat atomic mkdir.
technical_conclusion.current_fence_state: The saved observation found ROOT absent. This review did not create a fence or launch recovery.
technical_conclusion.linearization_point: ROOT.mkdir(mode=0o700) uses Path.mkdir default exist_ok=False, before any staged source write or the single systemd-run dispatch. Earlier exists/unit reads are not locks.
not_provided: No determination of which caller wins.
No proof that the winner reaches launch or finishes.
No authoritative H terminal, cancellation, retirement, or durable output receipt.
No fence over H admission/transport metadata or outer pre-mkdir processes.
No prevention of a delayed second admission if ROOT is later removed or renamed.
technical_conclusion.partial_winner_boundary: A winner interrupted by delayed cancellation can leave a partial ROOT; the losing call must not adopt it, clear it, use exist_ok=True or remove it to retry.
